svg.title: Simon — approved identity with an extended full-body composition
svg.desc: The approved portrait supplies the visible face, expression, hair, neck, collar, tie and upper gown through a single uniform photographic placement. The same-character generated continuation supplies only the lower body and clothing beyond the portrait crop; its entire head has been removed from the embedded derivative. No face is generated or warped by this composition.
svg.metadata: Selected approved portrait: metadata-free photographic derivatives, no identity or costume retouch. Head, face, hair, neck, collar and tie are overlaid from lossless crops whose decoded RGB pixels exactly match the approved master; the remaining upper garment uses its photographic JPEG derivative. Generated same-character continuation: derivative cropped at y280 before embedding, excluding its face and hair. Public composition uses native silhouette clips and clothing-edge alpha blends. It is a photographic upper-body passthrough with inferred body continuation, not an unaltered full-body photograph.
